Lancaster Guardian - Friday 03 July 1964 Page 2
OLD LANCASTRIAN CLUB (ROYAL GRAMMAR SCHOOL, LANCASTER). 
A War Memorial Pavilion has been erected on the School's Memorial Field (off Derwent Road) and will be dedicated by the Bishop of Lancaster (Rt. Rev. A. L. E. Hoskyns-Abrahall) on Saturday, 11th July, 1964 at 12.15 p.m.
 Parents and relatives of Old Boys of the School who gave their lives in the Second World War are invited to be present.
